items.title: Don't like AI in games? Crimson Desert studio Pearl Abyss ain't care: it's expanding AI use 'throughout our entire development pipeline'
items.summary: Pearl Abyss apologized for the presence of AI-generated art in Crimson Desert earlier this year, but it's not slowing down.
items.body: Earlier this year, Pearl Abyss apologized for the presence of AI-generated art in Crimson Desert—not because it had used generative AI, mind, but because players saw it. And it seems like the odds we might see more of it in the future are going up, as the studio said in its Q3 2026 earnings letter (via Eurogamer ) that it will be going even deeper on AI-powered development in the future. The first reference to AI comes midway through the letter: "While we previously validated game systems only after implementing them manually, we now utilize AI to rapidly validate diverse design concepts prior to actual implementation," it states. "This enables a more efficient allocation of development resources and enhances overall production speed." The studio immediately clarified, though, that AI "serves strictly as a tool to support concept validation and pipeline productivity," and that gameplay and content development "remain fully driven by our development team." The future will see more of the same, with the same caveats. "We are integrating AI technologies to enhance development productivity and overall quality," Pearl Abyss writes. items.body: في ليلة كروية استثنائية، أكد المنتخب المغربي أنه لا يعرف سوى لغة الانتصارات، بعدما حقق فوزًا كبيرًا ومستحقًا على نظيره النيجري بنتيجة 5-1، في المباراة التي جمعتهما اليوم الجمعة، ضمن التصفيات المؤهلة إلى كأس أمم إفريقيا، ليُثبت أسود الأطلس أنهم في طريقهم الصحيح نحو حجز بطاقة التأهل، وبأداء هجومي أمتع الجماهير الحاضرة. وافتتح ياسر زبيري التسجيل في الدقيقة 4 لأسود الأطلس، قبل أن يضيف القائد أشرف حكيمي الهدف الثاني (27)، ثم قلّص محمد عبد الرحمن الفارق للنيجر (41)، قبل أن يعود حكيمي ويُسجل الهدف الثالث (45+3)، قبل أن يضيف يوسف النصيري الرابع (77) ليقود أسود الأطلس إلى فوز مستحق. وبدأ المنتخب المغربي المباراة بقوة هجومية ضاربة، ولم يمنح ضيفه أي فرصة لالتقاط الأنفاس، فمنذ اللحظات الأولى، فرض رفاق أشرف حكيمي سيطرتهم الكاملة على مجريات اللعب، وضغطوا بكل قوة على دفاع النيجر، بحثًا عن هدف مبكر يفتح الطريق أمام فوز مريح. وجاء الهدف الأول سريعًا، عندما نجح المهاجم الشاب ياسر زبيري في افتتاح التسجيل في الدقيقة الرابعة، بعد هجمة منظمة وتمريرة متقنة، ليُشعل حماس الجماهير المغربية، ويؤكد أن المدرب محمد وهبي كان على حق عندما منحه الثقة لقيادة هجوم الأسود في هذه المواجهة. 🇲🇦⚽️🔥 ياسر الزابيري يفتتح التسجيل للمنتخب المغربي بعد تمريرة حاسمة من إبراهيم دياز! #تصفيات_كأس_أمم_إفريقيا pic.twitter.com/88…

items.summary: Pioner seemed headed in the right direction when it went into early access in late 2025, but it all went wrong just a few months later.
items.body: Pioner, a survival-shooter we said looked like " Stalker and Tarkov's alien baby " when we first laid eyes on it in 2021, is ending development and closing down. In an announcement posted today on Steam, developer GFAGames said further work on the game and continued operation of its servers requires more money, and it just doesn't have any. "Over the past few months, we have been in talks with existing and potential partners about investment and new ways of working together that would allow us to preserve the project and the team," the studio wrote. "We were unable to agree on the funding needed to continue the project. The studio no longer has sufficient funds of its own to continue development and keep the servers running." Pioner looked promising when it turned up at the PC Gaming Show in 2021: A mash-up of Stalker, Metro, and Escape From Tarkov that featured both a singleplayer campaign and online co-op and PvP survival action, all of it built around late Soviet-era technology. items.body: I reported earlier this week on a bug within AMD's GPU driver suite , wherein a misfiring utility was accused of making huge amounts of erroneous storage writes. Some AMD graphics card owners reported their SSD health dropping by up to 1% per month, but a fix has finally arrived. AMD Adrenalin Edition 26.11.1 is an optional update, which means you'll need to download the installer yourself. However, according to the topline notes, the update fixes "excessive writes to the system drive" at idle for Radeon RX 7000-series graphics cards and above. AMD's wording suggests that older GPUs might not be affected by the bug, but some of the user reports mention RX 6000-series cards, so it's unclear if a fix for earlier models is still in the works. I also think it's a slightly odd move to make this an "optional" update, given the severity of some of the reports, though this is often how AMD deals with getting fixes out in between official driver releases—by the looks of the known issues, this interim driver might still need some work before it's patched into the next full release. items.body: It was bad enough for Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang that he admitted to having an affair with someone , who people believe to be someone suspected of being a Chinese spy. But it's now come to light he has reportedly had a second affair with a member of Nvidia staff —Kimberly Powell, VP of healthcare. After this latest story it's looking more likely that Huang could be forced to resign. The question is what's next for Nvidia if the board today decides his tenure as the longest-serving Silicon Valley CEO should come to an end. Huang has been the image of the company in the eyes of the public for a long time, so whoever steps in to replace him will have a big leather jacket to fill. And whoever it is, it will be a major change for the company regardless. The doors are wide open for Nvidia in the long-term, so it's difficult to pin down with any certainty who any eventual replacement CEO would be, but in the interim the options are more limited. Here's who we could consider seeing as the new CEO of Nvidia. items.title: Nvidia stock price plunges amid second Jensen Huang affair allegation — the AI company could be set to lose hundreds of billions in value
items.summary: That's just under 10% of the company's market cap.
items.body: With a Democratic midterm win, a mini AI crash in China , and Jensen Huang admitted to an affair this Sunday , Nvidia was already in a tight spot. Now, a second affair allegation has come out about Nvidia's CEO, and the AI company's share price has taken a hit as a result. This reported second affair is said to be with another Nvidia exec, Kimberly Powell, and now the GPU company turned AI company is investigating whether or not it should oust the long-time CEO. Naturally, that instability is worrisome to some investors, who appear to be signalling distrust towards the company in light of these scandals. To put the stock dip into perspective, at close on Friday, Nvidia stock was worth $188.70 a share, a dip from a high of $239.24 on October 6. This morning, after-hours trading puts it at $161.88 , as of the time of writing. We haven't seen a share price as low as this for Nvidia since well over a year ago, at the end of June 2025.
